# mockingbird_mock (Data Source)

Reads a mock, including mocks declared in the server's config file (`source = "file"`), which resources cannot manage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a mock declared in the server's config file.
data "mockingbird_mock" "payments" {
  name = "payments"
}

output "payments_operations" {
  value = data.mockingbird_mock.payments.operations
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Mock name.

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Workspace. Defaults to the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `active_version` (Number) Active contract version; null when none.
- `consistency` (String) `on` or `off`.
- `contract_sha256` (String) Hex sha256 of the active contract source.
- `data_plane_auth_mode` (String) `none`, `api_key` or `passthrough_validate`.
- `default_scenario` (String) Scenario applied when a call names none.
- `header_overrides` (Boolean) Whether `X-Mockingbird-*` headers are honoured.
- `hosts` (List of String) Host names the mock answers for; empty for any.
- `id` (String) `<workspace>/<name>`.
- `llm_profile` (String) LLM profile.
- `operations` (List of String) Operations of the active contract, as targets (`GET /orders/{id}`).
- `persona` (String) Persona.
- `protocols` (List of String) Protocols of the active contract.
- `route_prefix` (String) Path prefix on the data plane.
- `source` (String) `api` or `file`.
- `unknown_ids` (String) `generate` or `404`.
- `url` (String) The provider's `data_plane_url` plus the route prefix; null without `data_plane_url`.
